findings.title: config.toml seed insertion point described loosely
findings.problem: Live sql_paths ends with instruments.sql then holidays.sql; 'appended after instruments.sql' would insert between them. Harmless, but not literally 'appended'.
findings.fix: Say 'append stress_scenarios.sql to the end of sql_paths; it has no FK dependency on holidays.sql so trailing placement is fine.'

findings.title: expo-crypto client UUID vs gen_random_uuid() unreconciled
findings.problem: expo-crypto is listed in the stack but record_simulation returns a server-generated id; no client UUID/idempotency key is needed. Risk of coder generating client ids needlessly.
findings.fix: Drop expo-crypto from the Stress Lab stack line or note that simulation ids are server-generated and no idempotency key is used; confirm double-submit is handled by disabling the run button while pending.

findings.title: COVID recovery-phase composition semantics implicit
findings.problem: Design says recovery is 'over the base' (reads as composed) but the RPC applies the recovery table to current holdings (independent). Two readings possible.
findings.fix: State explicitly: recovery is an independent shock from current holdings using the recovery table, not composed on the crash result; both phases are separate rows shown side by side; engine and RPC agree and a recovery example is tested.
